name: leader
tagline: Command-J, then one key, to split and move panes.
description: Drive the window from the keyboard with a prefix key, on cmux's own Command-J leader: Command-J then V or minus splits, Z zooms, E evens the splits, O floats the pane, C opens a terminal tab, A starts a chat beside you, D opens the diff, B hides the sidebar, X closes the tab. Command-J W, R or M then H, J, K or L moves focus, resizes or moves the tab. Holding Command shows the keys.
